title: The C. and O. Mounds
summary: In Johnson County, the C. and O. Mounds are two Adena burial mounds that William S. Webb dug and used to explain how Adena people lived.

items.text: Two mounds 1,600 ft apart in Johnson County, sites Jo 2 and Jo 9; excavated with WPA sponsorship, published by Webb 1942.
Both mounds over circular paired-post patterns, first recognized under Wright Mounds; overlapping alignments suggest reuse over time.
Webb: mound = important person over house, dispersed hamlets, cremated lesser dead (Webb 1942:361-362). Later digs found no villages; circles now read as mortuary structures.

timeline.event: Adena mound building in the Ohio Valley (general range; no site-specific dates used)

Clay's reassessment of the C&O pattern
